name: Tabs
label: Tabs
description: Tabs with an underline indicator, icons and counts, compact and full-width modes, and panels it can render itself.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the selected tab, for a controlled set. Leave it undefined to let
the component keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the tab selected on first render when the set is uncontrolled.
Falls back to the first enabled tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the value of the tab the user selects

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Whether tabs fill the available width

props.name: countLabel
props.description: What a screen reader hears after a tab's label for its count, given the count already written in the resolved locale. Defaults to ", 3"; say what it counts (", 3 unread") when the label does not.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the tab counts are written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop for the tab list.

rows.text: Moves focus into the list at the selected tab, and out of the list on the next press.
Moves to the next tab and selects it.
Moves to the previous tab and selects it.
Moves to the last tab and selects it.
Moves to the first tab and selects it.

alternatives.name: SegmentedControl
alternatives.when: the options switch a view mode or a filter
